assertions.title: State-changing endpoint without Authorization header is rejected
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 401; body={error:authentication required}; no Set-Cookie

assertions.title: Cookie-only auth attempt does not authenticate
assertions.command_run: curl -i -X POST with Cookie:session=<jwt> only, no Authorization
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 401; cookie-only auth properly rejected

assertions.title: Cross-origin state-changing request without bearer rejected
assertions.command_run: OPTIONS with Origin:evil.example + POST without auth
assertions.actual_result: OPTIONS HTTP 403; POST HTTP 401; ACAO not echoing evil.example
assertions.expected_result: ACAO not echoing evil.example OR POST 401

assertions.title: No Set-Cookie header issued on any endpoint
assertions.actual_result: Zero Set-Cookie headers across all endpoints

assertions.title: Malformed bearer token returns 400 with no token echo
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 400; body={error:malformed token}; no token echo in body

assertions.title: CSP header present on SPA root
assertions.actual_result: CSP contains all required directives: default-src, script-src, style-src, connect-src, img-src, font-src, frame-ancestors, report-uri

assertions.title: CSP connect-src includes external auth origin when configured
assertions.actual_result: connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:9999 present in CSP

assertions.title: CSP violation report endpoint accepts browser reports
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 204; report accepted

assertions.title: CSP report endpoint rejects oversized bodies
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 100 Continue then HTTP 400 Bad Request; body={error:invalid JSON body}; server healthy after

assertions.title: script-src hash covers theme bootstrap only
assertions.actual_result: script-src has exactly 1 sha256 hash, no unsafe-inline, no unsafe-eval

assertions.title: frame-ancestors none blocks embedding
assertions.actual_result: frame-ancestors 'none' present; X-Frame-Options: DENY present

assertions.title: Workspace-create rejects loopback repo URL (127.0.0.1)
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 400; error: clone URL targets a blocked host (private/internal network)

assertions.title: Safe-dial rejects ::1 IPv6 loopback
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 400; clone URL targets a blocked host (private/internal network)

assertions.title: Safe-dial rejects localhost hostname via DNS
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 400; clone URL targets a blocked host (private/internal network)

assertions.title: Safe-dial rejects RFC1918 10.0.0.0/8
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 400; clone URL targets a blocked host (private/internal network)

assertions.title: Safe-dial rejects 172.16.0.0/12
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 400; clone URL targets a blocked host (private/internal network)

assertions.title: Safe-dial rejects 192.168.0.0/16
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 400; clone URL targets a blocked host (private/internal network)

assertions.title: Safe-dial rejects link-local 169.254.0.0/16
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 400; clone URL targets a blocked host (private/internal network)

assertions.title: Safe-dial rejects GCP metadata hostname
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 400; clone URL targets a blocked host (private/internal network)

assertions.title: Safe-dial mitigates DNS rebinding via direct-IP connect
assertions.actual_result: Cannot set up DNS rebinding server in container
assertions.expected_result: All dial attempts connect to first-resolved IP
assertions.notes: Requires custom DNS server with 1s TTL alternating between public and private IPs. Safe-dial rejects private IPs directly (verified in SEC-013 thru SEC-020).

assertions.title: Non-https/ssh/git protocols rejected for repo URLs
assertions.command_run: POST /api/workspaces with file:// and ftp:// URLs
assertions.actual_result: file:// HTTP 400 (clone URL must start with https:// or git@); ftp:// HTTP 400 (same)

assertions.title: Redirect chain landing on private IP is blocked
assertions.actual_result: Cannot set up external redirect server
assertions.expected_result: Client error: blocked resolves to private IP
assertions.notes: Requires external server returning 302 to http://10.0.0.1/. Safe-dial rejects private IPs at connection time (verified in SEC-013 thru SEC-020).

assertions.title: File read endpoint rejects .. in path
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 404; body={error:file not found}; path traversal cleaned, no /etc/passwd content returned
assertions.expected_result: HTTP 403 (got 404 after path cleaning, equally secure)
assertions.notes: Server cleans .. from path, resulting in file-not-found rather than explicit 403.

assertions.title: Absolute paths escaping workspace rejected
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 404; body={error:file not found}; absolute path does not resolve outside agent worktree
assertions.expected_result: HTTP 403 (got 404 - absolute path stripped or cleaned)

assertions.title: Symlink escape rejected
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 403; body={error:path outside worktree}; symlink escape properly detected

assertions.title: Log read endpoint path-traversal safe
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 404; path traversal in log name rejected

assertions.title: Session-history endpoints enforce workspace scoping
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 404; no data leaked for non-existent workspace

assertions.title: Bearer token never logged verbatim
assertions.command_run: curl with recognizable marker token; grep auth logs
assertions.actual_result: Marker string absent from logs; logs show only method/path/status/duration/ip
assertions.log_evidence: Log shows: http request method=GET path=... status=400 duration_ms=... ip=... (no token)

assertions.title: Rejected token not echoed in 401 body
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 400; body={error:malformed token}; token string absent from body
assertions.notes: Got 400 for non-JWT-structured token. Token not echoed regardless.

assertions.title: JWT header kid not leaked in error
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 401; body={error:invalid or expired token}; kid absent from body

assertions.title: API key / worker token never logged verbatim
assertions.actual_result: Cannot restart loom serve with LOOM_WORKER_TOKEN without disrupting other layers
assertions.expected_result: Log grep for worker token returns zero hits
assertions.notes: Would require separate loom serve instance with LOOM_WORKER_TOKEN set.

assertions.title: UserIdentity.String() redacts email and name
assertions.command_run: curl with valid JWT containing email+name claims; grep logs
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 200; email (test@example.com) absent from logs; name (Test User) absent from logs
assertions.expected_result: Email and name absent from logs
assertions.log_evidence: Log shows only UserID, not email or name

assertions.title: Panic recovery does not leak stack with secrets
assertions.command_run: Malformed requests to trigger error paths
assertions.actual_result: Error responses contain only JSON error messages; no goroutine dumps, file paths, or variable names leaked
assertions.expected_result: No stack traces or file paths in error bodies

assertions.title: Cross-instance JWT replay rejected via aud claim
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 401; body={error:invalid or expired token}

assertions.title: JWT iss mismatch rejected
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 401; body={error:invalid or expired token}

assertions.title: Expired JWT rejected
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 401; body={error:invalid or expired token}

assertions.title: alg=none attack rejected
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 401; body={error:invalid or expired token}

assertions.title: JWKS fetch over http rejected when auth-url is https
assertions.actual_result: Server logs warning: --auth-url uses http:// with non-loopback host. Use https:// or add --auth-allow-insecure.
assertions.expected_result: Startup fails or warns requiring --auth-allow-insecure or https
assertions.notes: Server starts but logs explicit warning about insecure JWKS fetch. Not a hard failure but clear warning.

assertions.title: JWKS cache respects max size and TTL
assertions.actual_result: N/A
assertions.expected_result: Server RSS plateaus; JWKS cache bounded
assertions.notes: Contract marks as [DEFERRED, verify implementation] - metric exposure may not exist

assertions.title: TLS certificate validation enforced for JWKS fetch
assertions.actual_result: JWKS initial fetch failed: tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
assertions.log_evidence: JWKS fetch error logged with x509 certificate verification failure

assertions.title: /api/client-errors rate-limited per IP
/api/csp-report rate-limited per IP (cross-ref SEC-010)
assertions.actual_result: Same as SEC-010: 20 of 40 requests returned 429

assertions.title: Auth-config endpoint rate-limited
assertions.actual_result: All 50 requests returned 401 Unauthorized. Auth middleware runs before rate limiter for this endpoint.
assertions.notes: The /api/config endpoint requires auth in auth mode, returning 401 for all unauthenticated requests. Cannot test rate limiting. See also auth-flow AUTH-042.

assertions.title: Health endpoint is NOT rate-limited
assertions.actual_result: 200 requests: all returned 200, zero 429s

assertions.title: Authenticated mutation endpoints rate-limited per IP at default 20 qps burst 40
assertions.actual_result: 55 OK (201), 45 rate-limited (429)

assertions.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses
assertions.actual_result: All endpoints carry X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff

assertions.title: X-Frame-Options: DENY
assertions.actual_result: X-Frame-Options: DENY present

assertions.title: Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
assertions.actual_result: Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin present

assertions.title: Permissions-Policy disables camera/mic/geo/payment
assertions.actual_result: Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=() all present

assertions.title: HSTS header emitted only when HSTSEnabled config set
assertions.actual_result: Strict-Transport-Security header absent (not configured)
assertions.notes: Only tested absence without config; presence with config would require server restart.

assertions.title: Bearer extraction is case-insensitive per RFC 6750
assertions.actual_result: Bearer=200, bearer=200, BEARER=200 - all identical
assertions.expected_result: All three produce identical HTTP status

assertions.title: Authorization header without Bearer prefix treated as unauthenticated
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 401; body={error:authentication required}

assertions.title: CORS preflight for unknown origin returns no ACAO echo
assertions.actual_result: Response lacks Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://evil
assertions.expected_result: Response lacks ACAO echo for evil origin

assertions.title: WebSocket upgrade requires one-time token
assertions.actual_result: HTTP 400 {error:missing session parameter}; Bearer auth not accepted for WS; no Set-Cookie. Endpoint requires session parameter, not standard bearer.
assertions.expected_result: First token use succeeds; second rejected; no Set-Cookie
assertions.notes: Endpoint rejects Bearer auth requiring session parameter. Cannot fully test one-time token flow without session token generation endpoint.

assertions.title: CSP report endpoint rate-limited per IP
assertions.actual_result: 20 accepted (204), 20 rate-limited (429)
